## What to build

The supervisor gives each independent assignment a fresh worker and cuts independent ready work apart instead of loading it serially onto one worker (#754 supervisor half, folded in by owner decision 2026-11-13). Given a closed implementation assignment and independent ready work within actual resource limits, it assigns the work to a new worker with a different provider-session identity and a self-contained brief; given independently ready work, it splits it across workers within limits rather than queueing it behind one.

Proof is a factory eval as the pilot's recipe; also the frozen gh754 suites (private copy in the factory state dir carry/gh754-evals; evidence gh754-corrector 35d01c7): train cases may be read, held-out cases are only run, never read by the implementer. Seams: pilot ticket's table.

## What to build

Review rework of PR #1008 (verdict on 40e33c77). A writer or reviewer runs `octo-feather-lane seam TICKET <spec>#<anchor> SEAM --before REV` and gets an exact answer on the `Seam:` record contract: exit 0 recorded before REV; exit 1 no `Seam:` record for that criterion, or the record took its form after REV; a distinct non-zero exit, "unchecked", when the tracker cannot say when the record took its form (Linear description: updatedAt is not its edit time), never reported as late. `issue-view KEY --notes` is proved on unmodified real GitHub answers; Linear on a tape whose source states how it was built, as the director's #921 decision allows while LINEAR_API_KEY is absent. Tests assert independent expected values (the scratch commit's own SHA from git).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] quality#acceptance-public-surfaces: the seam check passes on a real ticket whose `Seam:` line predates the test commit, and fails exit 1 on #876's real order (record after test 74f80a78)
- [ ] skills#acceptance-tracker-scripts: `issue-view KEY --notes` on github-issues and linear prints the notes with written and edited times, or exits non-zero naming the time it cannot give
- [ ] demo: `octo-feather-lane seam 876 roles#acceptance-fresh-independent-worker herdr-spawn --before 74f80a78` exits 1 naming unlisted-test-seam, and `octo-feather-lane seam <this ticket> quality#acceptance-public-surfaces 'octo-feather-lane seam' --before <the rework's test commit>` exits 0

## Seams

Seam: quality#acceptance-public-surfaces: `octo-feather-lane seam` the kit CLI, driven as a command, its tracker read through the tracker skill's issue-view
Seam: skills#acceptance-tracker-scripts: `issue-view` the tracker skill script, `--notes`, its tracker CLI (gh, linear) replayed from recorded answers

None (can start immediately)
